correctness.rationale: For integer trace t>=3 and q>=2 equal-width vertical coordinate bins, invertible toral dynamics preserve Haar. Every pair of observation coordinate row vectors has nonzero integer determinant via the recurrence a_(h+1)=t a_h-a_(h-1), so pair maps push Haar to independent Haar. Conditional on first two bins the fractional parts U,V are iid uniform, giving C2=t C1-C0+floor(tV-U) mod q; exact strip integration assigns endpoint probability 1/(2t), interior 1/t. The root-of-unity Laurent generating polynomial (1+z^-1)sum_{j=0}^{t-1}z^j/(2t) vanishes on all nontrivial qth roots precisely for q=2 or q|t. Haar central inversion kills the third signed moment of every distinct-time binary triple, and pairwise independence then implies all three-bit uniforms. CMI equals log q-H(w); for q>=t+1 all nonzero residues distinct, yielding log(q/t)-(log 2)/t. Independent rational polygon clipping checked 270 strips t3..22, and all 720 tested t,q pairs passed; unrestricted proof is Fourier/covering, not finite extrapolation.
